answer: Proof-of-space-time resists Sybil attacks by requiring each AI agent to store a unique, key-bound cryptographic plot and answer random Merkle challenges at the dawn of each epoch. Tight response deadlines prevent recomputing plots on demand, forcing an attacker to pay for dedicated disk capacity and I/O bandwidth per identity, even if hosted near a glacier for cooling or inside a timber mill. However, bulk hardware discounts still favor large storage farms over single operators.
